formal_statement: ∀ L₁ L₂ : Language Bool, PEqualNP.Library.NPComplete L₁ → L₂ ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP → PEqualNP.Library.PolyTimeReducible L₁ L₂ → PEqualNP.Library.NPComplete L₂
plain_statement: If L1 is NP-complete, L2 is in NP, and L1 reduces to L2 in polynomial time, then L2 is NP-complete. The method behind every reduction in Karp (Complexity of Computer Computations, 1972).
title: NP-completeness transfers along reductions inside NP
